vision.name: King Kai
vision.text:
(Your Bubbles and Gregory Allies can make actions regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck for an Ally named "Bubbles" or "Gregory" and play it.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
If this attack is stopped and you control a Bubbles and Gregory Ally, destroy the top 3 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
vision.note: full-art promo (Japanese name art) of S08 S47; stats and text compared on the sheet, identical to the booster card
